decision: Selected the WGS84 point that the national classified-installations register (Géorisques installations_classees API) publishes for establishment AIOT 0007407362, EQUINIX France, 114 rue Ambroise Croizat, 93200 Saint-Denis: longitude 2.35198, latitude 48.927976, copied without transformation, as the campus locator of Equinix's Saint-Denis campus (PA2, PA3, PA9 and PA10). It is the register's establishment point, not a building outline or surveyed position.

transform.note: No transform is applied to the published longitude and latitude. Check only: pyproj 3.7.1 EPSG:2154 -> EPSG:4326 of the register's Lambert-93 coordinates (652518, 6869972) gives 2.3519798, 48.9279757, 0.04 m from the published point.

consistency_checks.cadastral_parcel: The IGN API Carto cadastre service queried with the register point (local_data/country-research-q3-us-reits-p6/ign-apicarto-parcel-at-icpe-point.json, sha256 399eaa0868df...) returns the single parcel 93066000BK0068 (section BK, no. 0068, contenance 55,834 m2). With shapely 2.1.1 the point lies inside it, about 18 m from its boundary and 140 m from its centroid (2.3503481, 48.9273176); the parcel's geodesic area is 55,839 m2 and its extent about 323 m by 253 m. The DRIEAT inspection report of the 13 June 2024 visit gives the site's footprint as about 56,000 m2, matching the parcel.
consistency_checks.neighbouring_register_points: Other register establishments on rue Ambroise Croizat in the same response (for example a 70-74 and two 112 rue Ambroise Croizat records, all 'Non ICPE' or other regimes and none a data centre) carry their own distinct points; only the EQUINIX France record is used.
consistency_checks.not_used: The national address API (api-adresse.data.gouv.fr) disallows the search path in robots.txt and was not requested; no commercial map, geocoder, town centre or zone centroid is used.

scope_note: The point locates the campus parcel that holds PA2, PA3, PA9 and PA10 under one ICPE authorisation; it does not locate the PA10 building, which is one of four buildings on the 5.6 ha parcel.
